# Shivam Singh — AI/ML Engineer Portfolio

> Portfolio of Shivam Singh, an AI/ML Engineer specializing in machine learning, deep learning, NLP, OCR, and autonomous agents. Remote-first, based in Rewa, India.

Shivam is a remote-ready AI/ML Engineer with hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems, RAG pipelines, computer vision, and OCR solutions. The site showcases his work, experience, certifications, education, and writing on AI strategy.
